emma: Heads up: after switching to new embeddings endpoint, our reranker shows wildly different order. error: `Dim mismatch: got 2048 expected 1024`

ricardo: which SDKs are impacted?

emma: python sampleapp + go retriever. API now returns 2048 for model=fast-2048, sampleapp still expects 1024. go batcher truncates incoming vectors during retry merge, python retries as a second call producing duplicates in candidate list.

ci-bot: [1730123460] 401 -> refresh -> 200 for POST /v1/embeddings req=ef7

sam: classic parity + retry interplay. Short-term mitigation: enable strict dim validation in batch helper and require Idempotency-Key on retries. Longer: canonicalize response field to `embedding` across SDKs and make batchers preserve raw vectors until validation.

emma: i'll push a quick sampleapp patch to validate dims and set idempotency header. patch link (wip): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/120

ricardo: i'll update go batcher: defer truncation, add opt-in strict mode, and map `vectors`->`embedding` for backward compat. opening PR now.

sam: suggested tiny workaround snippets to share in onboarding:

Python:
```python
resp = client.embeddings.create(text)
vec = resp.get('embedding') or resp.get('vectors')
if len(vec) != CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM:
    raise RuntimeError('unexpected embedding dim')
client.headers.update({'Idempotency-Key': request_id})
```

JS:
```js
const vec = resp?.data?.[0]?.embedding || resp?.data?.[0]?.vector;
if (!vec || vec.length !== EXPECTED_DIM) throw new Error('bad dim');
client.defaults.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = reqId;
```
